content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment covers four Group-C posts with a combined total of 210 vacancies, as shown below. The notification clarifies that the number of vacancies and their category-wise breakup are provisional and may be revised by the Directorate of Municipal Administration before the examination; any revision will be communicated separately.

rows.post_name: Assistant Water Supply Operator (Sahayaka Neeru Sarabaraju Operator)

content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be an Indian citizen. A candidate who has a living spouse and remarries without obtaining prior permission from the Government is not eligible; similarly, a woman who marries a man who already has a living wife is not eligible for appointment without such permission. Candidates must be physically and mentally fit to perform the duties of the post without any impediment. The decision of the medical board conducting the examination for the appointing authority is final in this regard. Candidates dismissed for cheating or impersonation in any examination conducted by the Union or Karnataka Public Service Commission, any other State Public Service Commission, KEA, or any university are not eligible. Candidates temporarily debarred from any recruitment examination conducted by the Union or Karnataka Public Service Commission, any other State Public Service Commission, KEA, any university, or any employer are considered ineligible for the entire debarment period.

content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: As per Government Order No. CI 81 SSNE 2017 dated 27.02.2018, the following are also treated as equivalent to SSLC: the Class 10 examinations conducted by CBSE and ICSE boards; the Class 10 examinations conducted by other State education boards; secondary-level courses of the National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS); and secondary-level courses conducted by the Karnataka State Open School Education Board. Candidates must possess the qualifications and certificates specified above as on the last date of application submission. Candidates awaiting their results, or who do not yet have the required marks card or certificate, must not apply. Original certificates must be produced at the time of document verification; failure to do so will lead to cancellation of candidature.

rows.qualification_required: Passed SSLC or an equivalent examination; AND holds an ITI two-year course certificate in Electrical or Fitter Trade from a Government-recognised Industrial Training Institute resulting in a National Trade Certificate (NTC); AND has completed one year of Apprenticeship Training in any industry resulting in a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).

Passed SSLC or an equivalent examination; AND has passed a two-year course in Electrical Trade from a Government-recognised Industrial Training Institute resulting in an NTC; AND has completed one year of Apprenticeship Training resulting in an NAC.
Passed SSLC or an equivalent examination; AND has passed a two-year course in Electrical or Fitter Trade from a Government-recognised Industrial Training Institute resulting in an NTC.
Passed SSLC or an equivalent examination; AND has passed a two-year course in Electrical Trade from a Government-recognised Industrial Training Institute resulting in an NTC.

content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: As per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, candidates must be at least 18 years old as on the last date of application submission. As per Government Order No. CI 262 SENE 2026 dated 29.01.2026, a one-time relaxation of 5 years has been given to the maximum age limit for General Merit candidates. Additional age relaxation (over and above the above limits, up to the ceilings specified in the Karnataka Civil Services Rules, 1977) applies to certain categories, including: employees of Karnataka State Government/local authorities/State or Central Act-established institutions and Government undertakings (relaxation equal to years of service, capped at 10 years); ex-servicemen (relaxation equal to service period plus 3 years); full-time National Cadet Corps supervisors (relaxation equal to years served as cadet supervisor); persons working as Gram Samooha Inspectors under a rural employment guarantee scheme (relaxation equal to years of such service); special-incentive category candidates (10 years); employees of the Census organisation of the Government of India in Karnataka (relaxation equal to years of service, capped at 5 years); widows who have not remarried and have no plans to (10 years, subject to a certificate from the competent authority); and retrenched employees eligible for retrenchment compensation under the applicable rules (10 years, subject to verification of a District Magistrate certificate). Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years from the date of direct appointment. The applicable pay scales are as follows: Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-1: Rs. 37,500-900-39,300-1,000-43,300-1,125-47,800-1,250-52,800-1,375-58,300-1,500-64,300-1,650-74,200-1,900-76,100 Assistant Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-2: Rs. 34,100-800-35,700-900-39,300-1,000-43,300-1,125-47,800-1,250-52,800-1,375-58,300-1,500-64,300-1,650-67,600 The National Pension Scheme (NPS) is applicable to all four posts.

content_sections.heading: KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a competitive written examination consisting of two papers. The minimum qualifying marks in the competitive examination for General Merit candidates is 35%. Each wrong answer carries a negative mark of 0.25 (one-fourth of a mark); marking more than one answer for a question is treated as a wrong answer, while an unanswered question does not attract any deduction. Candidates who have studied Kannada as a first or second language up to SSLC or a higher level, or through a degree/diploma course, or who have already passed a Kannada language test conducted by any competent authority, are exempt from a separate Kannada Language Test. Other candidates must additionally clear a compulsory, qualifying-only Kannada Language Paper of 150 marks, with a minimum qualifying score of 50 marks; this paper is not counted towards the merit ranking. The examination will be conducted in Online (CBT) or Offline OMR mode; the mode and examination centres will be announced later on the KEA website.

faq.question: Q1. What is KEA Kalyana Karnataka Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Karnataka Examinations Authority, on behalf of the Directorate of Municipal Administration, to fill 210 Group-C posts of Water Supply Operator, Electrician Grade-1, Assistant Water Supply Operator, and Electrician Grade-2 in the urban local bodies of the Kalyana-Karnataka region.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: A total of 210 vacancies are available across the four posts, subject to any revision by the Directorate of Municipal Administration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application can be submitted up to 07 October 2026 (Extended)

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates need SSLC or an equivalent qualification along with an ITI certificate in the relevant trade (Electrical or Fitter), and for the Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-1 posts, an additional one year of Apprenticeship Training resulting in an NAC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum age is 40 years for General Merit, 43 years for Category 2A/2B/3A/3B, and 45 years for SC/ST/Category-1 candidates, as on the last date of application, with additional relaxations available for specific categories as detailed in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 750/- for General Merit and other categories, Rs. 500/- for SC/ST/Category-1/Ex-servicemen/Third Gender candidates, and Rs. 250/- for special-incentive category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official KEA website at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a competitive written examination comprising a General Knowledge paper (Paper-1) and a post-specific subject paper (Paper-2), along with a qualifying Kannada Language Test for candidates who have not already met the Kannada-language exemption criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The pay scale is Rs. 37,500–76,100 for Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-1, and Rs. 34,100–67,600 for Assistant Water Supply Operator and Electrician Grade-2, with National Pension Scheme benefits applicable.
